summary: Graphex Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC as a foreign private issuer in July 2026, attaching two HKSE announcements: one covering poll results of the annual general meeting, and another announcing the appointment of an independent non-executive director and changes in board committee composition along with re-compliance with listing rules. These are routine corporate governance and meeting outcome disclosures. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC activity is indicated. The filing confirms director appointment without forced departure, rendering it a routine disclosure.
